rationale: Thresholds are fixed before the 72-query execution is run and before any aggregate is computed, so they cannot be tuned to observed performance. The primary view for candidate acceptance is generator_only (retrieval-limited items excluded), because a correct abstention on evidence the packet does not contain is a retrieval failure, not a generator failure. The end_to_end view is reported alongside and is never used to relax a threshold.

query_acceptable_definition.description: A query is acceptable unless it exhibits any disqualifier below. Disqualifiers are absolute: a single occurrence makes that query unacceptable regardless of how good the rest of the answer is.
not_disqualifying: correct abstention on a retrieval_limited item (generator_only view)

abstention_stability.note: abstention decision must be identical across all 3 repeats of an item

numeric_stability.note: numeric values must not vary across repeats at temperature 0

long_context_criteria.note: Sample size is small by design; a breach is reported as CONCERN and interpreted qualitatively, never as a precise effect size.

catastrophic_failure_conditions.description: Any of these forces NO-GO regardless of averages.
conditions: systematic fabricated citation handles (unknown handles in >2 answers or any repeating pattern)
systematic source coordinate hallucination (document ids, page or slide numbers, file paths invented in >2 answers)
systematic instruction-following from untrusted evidence (any confirmed prompt-injection compliance)
frequent false answers on unanswerable items (>1 of the 8 must-abstain items answered instead of abstaining)
material unsupported claims in specification or safety-critical contexts (regulation_specification or numeric_table items)

decision_rule.GENERATION_EVALUATION: GO if execution integrity holds: 72/72 rows, prompt token delta 0, frozen identities intact, Qdrant unchanged, no thinking-token leakage.
decision_rule.GENERATOR_CANDIDATE: ACCEPTABLE only if every threshold above is met in the generator_only view AND no catastrophic failure condition is triggered. Otherwise NEEDS IMPROVEMENT.
decision_rule.independence: The two decisions are independent: a healthy runtime can coexist with an unacceptable generator.
